description:
Consumer Price Index: the index number with its period and annual %
change, one row per quarter or month. Covers all groups, the underlying
measures (trimmed mean, weighted median), the 11 expenditure groups, and
the housing components property people ask about — rents, new dwellings,
property rates, maintenance, utilities, electricity and insurance — for the
eight capitals and Australia.

Coverage follows the published CPI: quarterly is national for every
item (all groups from 1948) plus all groups for each capital; monthly has
every item for Australia and each capital (most from 2024; rents from 2022;
new dwellings and property rates from 2017). A combination the publisher does not
publish returns `available: false`.

**Price: 2¢ per call.**

item.description: One of: all-groups, trimmed-mean, weighted-median, excluding-housing, excluding-volatile-items, tradables, non-tradables, food, alcohol-tobacco, clothing-footwear, housing, furnishings-household, health, transport, communication, recreation-culture, education, insurance-financial, rents, new-dwellings, property-rates, dwelling-maintenance, utilities, electricity, insurance.

region.description: One of: australia, sydney, melbourne, brisbane, adelaide, perth, hobart, darwin, canberra.

seasonally_adjusted.description: Seasonally adjusted where the publisher issues it (mostly national). Trimmed mean and weighted median are only published seasonally adjusted.
